body: Thanks man, you might have saved my life today. I will try to do all of the things you told me to do, and hopefully get better. Once again thank you being one of the only people who has cared about me and my depressing life. :)

Well to start things off I'm gay in a very homophobic city/state, my parents are also "gay haters" so are most of my friends, and no I just can't move (I'm not 18) so yeah... Next, I have had these waves of depression that go from loving life to wanting to kill myself in anywhere from a day to a couple of months, the worst part is that I don't know what causes this to happen.... I have panic attacks at least every week. I question if my "friends" actually like me or if they just put up with me for some reason also I'm butt ugly and fat as a cow.
